verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents natural-language interaction through its AI SRE. Users can ask in plain language for recent logs or chart visualizations, tag @betterstack in Slack to have it investigate incidents, and chat with it online, in Slack, MS Teams, or Claude Code via its MCP server. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can perform write and configuration actions (creating monitors, acknowledging or resolving incidents, editing schedules), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing pages.
